name: Web Page to Markdown → daily rows (Apify, publicrecords)

nodes.name: Run Web Page to Markdown on Apify
nodes.notes: Create a Header Auth credential: name = Authorization, value = Bearer <your Apify API token> (console.apify.com/settings/integrations). Runs bill to your own Apify account at the Store price.

parameters.content:
## Web Page to Markdown
Turn web page URLs into clean, LLM-ready Markdown over plain HTTP (no browser). Not a site crawler: you choose the URLs. For JavaScript-only pages, use js-page-to-markdown instead.

Store page: https://apify.com/publicrecords/url-to-markdown
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/url-to-markdown

Edit the JSON body to change the input, then connect the output to Google Sheets, Slack, Airtable or email.
